For each flight, use the dataset conventions: scheduled flights include cancelled flights for busiest-route counts; route is unordered, so canonicalize each origin/destination pair by alphabetically sorting the two airport codes and joining with '-'. For each carrier, identify the route with the largest total number of scheduled records, counting cancelled flights. Separately, among routes having at least 20 completed flights (cancelled=false; actual_dep present), compute departure delay as actual_dep minus sched_dep in minutes, treating a flight as delayed only when delay >15 minutes, and identify the route with the highest delayed/completed rate. Handle times crossing midnight if needed. Return the requested route names and also supporting counts/rates for verification. Do not use weather.

Analyze carriers AA and UA for January and February 2025. Use all records in the provided carrier files for those two months. Canonicalize each route as the two airport codes sorted alphabetically and joined by '-'; direction does not matter. Busiest means the route with the most scheduled flights, counting cancelled flights. Worst means the route with the highest delayed/completed rate among routes with at least 20 completed (non-cancelled) flights. A flight is delayed when actual departure minus scheduled departure exceeds 15 minutes; early departures are not delayed. Exclude cancelled flights from both numerator and denominator for delay rate. Correctly handle clock-time subtraction across midnight if present. Return route, counts, and percentage rate for checking. Do not use weather.

Analyze carriers B6 and AS for January and February 2025. For B6, date and departure times are local at the origin. For AS, columns are date_utc, sched_dep_utc, and actual_dep_utc; convert UTC timestamps to local time at the origin using airports.csv utc_offset_hours before selecting January-February 2025 flights, because dates/months refer to local origin time. (Delay duration itself can equivalently be computed in UTC, with actual minus scheduled, including possible midnight crossing.) For each carrier, canonicalize routes by sorting the two airport codes alphabetically and joining with '-'. Busiest route: highest count of scheduled flights, including cancelled flights. Worst route: highest delayed/completed rate among routes with at least 20 completed non-cancelled flights. Delayed means departure delay >15 minutes; cancelled flights are excluded from numerator and denominator. Return supporting counts and one-decimal percentage rates, and state any tie-breaking used if a tie occurs. Do not use weather.

plan.synthesis_plan: Combine the six carrier results, checking that each report applied unordered alphabetical route canonicalization, included cancellations only for busiest counts, required at least 20 completed flights for worst-route eligibility, and used delay >15 minutes. For AS, verify the UTC-to-origin-local month filtering and use the requested route strings. Resolve any reported ties by inspecting supporting counts or applying a consistent deterministic rule, then output only the required JSON mapping each carrier to busiest and worst route strings.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
for carrier in ['WN','DL']:
 d=pd.read_csv('airlines/'+carrier+'.csv')
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 print('\n',carrier,'dates',d.date.min(),d.date.max(),'cancel vals',d.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
 print('busy',d.route.value_counts().head(10).to_dict())
 # completed cancelled false actual present
 comp=d[(d.cancelled.astype(str).str.lower()=='false') & d.actual_dep.notna()].copy()
 def mins(x):
  h,m=map(int,x.split(':')); return h*60+m
 comp['delay']=comp.apply(lambda r:(mins(r.actual_dep)-mins(r.sched_dep))%1440,axis=1)
 comp['delayed']=comp.delay>15
 z=comp.groupby('route').agg(completed=('route','size'),delayed=('delayed','sum'))
 z['rate_pct']=100*z.delayed/z.completed
 print(z[z.completed>=20].sort_values(['rate_pct','completed'],ascending=False).to_string())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
out={}
for carrier in ['AA','UA']:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'airlines/{carrier}.csv')
 d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 d=d[d.date.dt.month.isin([1,2])].copy()
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 # all records scheduled count
 busy=d.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
 # calculate completed and delays
 comp=d[~d.cancelled.astype(bool)].copy()
 def diff(r):
  s=int(r.sched_dep[:2])*60+int(r.sched_dep[3:]); a=int(r.actual_dep[:2])*60+int(r.actual_dep[3:]); x=a-s
  if x < -720: x+=1440
  elif x > 720: x-=1440
  return x
 comp['delaymins']=comp.apply(diff,axis=1)
 stats=comp.groupby('route').agg(completed=('route','size'),delayed=('delaymins',lambda x:(x>15).sum()))
 stats=stats[stats.completed>=20].copy(); stats['rate']=stats.delayed/stats.completed
 worst=stats.sort_values(['rate','completed','delayed'],ascending=[False,True,False]).iloc[0]
 print(carrier,'rows',len(d),'busy',busy.head().to_dict(),'worst',worst.to_dict())
 print(stats.sort_values('rate',ascending=False).head(10))
 out[carrier]={'busiest':{'route':busy.index[0],'scheduled_count':int(busy.iloc[0])},'worst':{'route':worst.name,'completed':int(worst.completed),'delayed':int(worst.delayed),'rate_pct':round(float(worst.rate*100),1)}}
print(out)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from datetime import timedelta
b=pd.read_csv('airlines/B6.csv'); a=pd.read_csv('airlines/AS.csv'); ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv')
off=ap.set_index('airport').utc_offset_hours
# B6 local date parse
b['dt_sched']=pd.to_datetime(b.date+' '+b.sched_dep)
b['route']=b.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
b=b[b.dt_sched.dt.to_period('M').astype(str).isin(['2025-01','2025-02'])].copy()
b['delay_min']=(pd.to_datetime(b.date+' '+b.actual_dep)-b.dt_sched).dt.total_seconds()/60
# AS UTC parse then local scheduled datetime
for c in ['sched_dep_utc','actual_dep_utc']:
 a[c+'_dt']=pd.to_datetime(a.date_utc+' '+a[c])
a['local_sched']=a.sched_dep_utc_dt + a.origin.map(off).map(lambda x:pd.Timedelta(hours=x))
a['route']=a.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
a=a[a.local_sched.dt.to_period('M').astype(str).isin(['2025-01','2025-02'])].copy()
a['delay_min']=(a.actual_dep_utc_dt-a.sched_dep_utc_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
for name,d in [('B6',b),('AS',a)]:
 d['cancelled']=d.cancelled.astype(bool)
 counts=d.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
 comp=d[~d.cancelled].groupby('route').size()
 delayed=d[(~d.cancelled)&(d.delay_min>15)].groupby('route').size()
 x=pd.DataFrame({'completed':comp,'delayed':delayed}).fillna(0); x['rate']=x.delayed/x.completed*100
 print('\n',name,'rows',len(d),'busiest\n',counts.head(10), 'ties',counts[counts==counts.max()])
 print('worst eligible',x[x.completed>=20].sort_values('rate',ascending=False).head(10), 'ties max',x[(x.completed>=20)&(x.rate==x[x.completed>=20].rate.max())])
 print('cancel',d.cancelled.sum(), 'routes',d.route.unique())
